subject: Air-gapped / VPC deployment: rapid feasibility + resourcing ask
messages:
From: Ethan Park <ethan_park@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2027-05-30T09:12:00Z
Subject: Air-gapped / VPC deployment: rapid feasibility + resourcing ask

Folks —

Acme Health (contact: infra@acmehealth.com) opened a firm request today for an air-gapped on-prem evaluation plus a VPC-only fallback path. They want a short feasibility summary and a rough resourcing/cost estimate for their procurement packet by next Friday. Key asks from procurement/security: KMS integration options, data-at-rest handling, audit trail retention, and a minimal pilot timeline.

Can each of you give a quick scan by EOD tomorrow on the following:
- Marissa: architecture-level blockers (KV cache persistence, model weight storage, upgrade path) and whether we can support an air-gapped runtime with our current serving layer.
- Rishi: ballpark infra + SRE resourcing and a minimal bill-of-materials for a 3-month pilot.
- Laura: compliance gating (SOC2 evidence, network controls) and whether we need a formal exception or legal signoff to pursue on-prem.

Attached: private-deploy-quick-checklist.xlsx (initial checklist).

I will coordinate a short sync with Acme after we have the scan. Thanks — this is high priority for revenue and compliance.

— Ethan
Ethan Park
Head of Product Operations, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Park <ethan_park@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-30T12:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Air-gapped / VPC deployment: rapid feasibility + resourcing ask

Ethan — quick read below, high level only. Happy to expand in a follow-up.

Summary: On-prem (air-gapped) is possible but nontrivial; main constraints are (1) model artifact distribution and updates, (2) KV cache durability for warmup across restarts, (3) telemetry and observability without egress.

Notes:
- Model distribution: We need an offline packaging flow (signed tarball + checksum) and an install agent for the customer environment. That is not productionized today; we have a prototype.
- KV cache: To keep latency SLAs, we prefer local NVMe-backed persistent cache with periodic snapshot/restore. Requires file-system-level lock and a migration plan for model hot-swapping.
- Telemetry: For air-gapped, we'll need a local metrics collector + a pull system for logs; security will likely demand encrypted bundles and signed ingestion.

Blocked items to resolve for viability:
- KMS: integration pattern for a customer-managed HSM (PKCS#11 or cloud KMS adjacency).
- Upgrade procedure: tested rollback for model and runtime changes with customer-controlled windows.

I attached a short note with architecture sketches (kms-integration-notes.md). Rough ETA for a more detailed feasibility doc: 7–10 business days if we spin up a small task force. For a rapid reply to Acme, I can produce a 1-page risk checklist + recommended pilot configuration by tomorrow EOD.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Serving Infrastructure
Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ethan Park <ethan_park@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-30T15:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Air-gapped / VPC deployment: rapid feasibility + resourcing ask

Ethan/Marissa/Laura — preliminary sizing for a conservative pilot (3 months) below. This is a rapid scan; I'll refine once we agree on pilot scope.

Minimal pilot footprint (example):
- Serving: 3 x A40-equivalent nodes (or 2x A100 depending on model family) with 1.5TB NVMe each for model/cache snapshots.
- Control plane: single dedicated coordinator (m4.xlarge equivalent) inside customer VPC for orchestration (no egress).
- SRE: 0.5 FTE for onboarding + 1 SRE on-call at 25% for pilot operations (3 months).
- Engineering: 1 engineer (2 weeks) to build packaging/install scripts + 1 engineer (1 month) for KV persistence and rollback testing.

Estimated bill-of-materials (rough): see attached estimated-bom-v1.csv. Ballpark infra rental + setup costs for pilot: $85k–$120k (US), plus engineering effort.

Dependencies / risks:
- Customer-managed KMS requires key-wrapping support in the runtime; if HSM is required we need a short design and 2–3 weeks of integration testing.
- If Acme requires no external observability egress, post-mortem and regression workflows will be heavier.

If the ask is to prioritize VPC-only (no air-gap), costs drop ~40% and timeline compresses to 4–6 weeks for pilot.

—Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Staff Infrastructure Engineer
Redwood Inference
From: Acme Health <infra@acmehealth.com>
To: Ethan Park <ethan_park@redwood.com>
Cc: CloudOps Partners <partners@cloudops.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-31T08:17:00Z
Subject: Re: Air-gapped / VPC deployment: rapid feasibility + resourcing ask

Thanks Ethan, Marissa, Rishi — appreciate the quick turnaround. A few clarifications from our security team:
- We prefer an air-gapped on-prem pilot but will accept a VPC-only deployment if the observability/forensics story is identical and keys remain customer-managed.
- Can you confirm whether the pilot requires internet access for model downloads? If so, can that be done via an approved jumpbox controlled by Acme?

Next steps for us: please provide the 1-page risk checklist + pilot BOM and a proposed calendar for a 30–45 minute technical kickoff next week. Also include whether Redwood will require an exception to standard support SLAs.

Regards,
Samira Qureshi
Infra Lead, Acme Health
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Park <ethan_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2027-05-31T15:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Air-gapped / VPC deployment: rapid feasibility + resourcing ask

Team — thanks for the rapid inputs. Decision notes and next steps:

Decision: Proceed with a two-track reply to Acme — (A) VPC-only pilot option (fast path) and (B) air-gapped on-prem option with higher cost and a 6–8 week integration window. We will present both options and clearly call out differences in cost/ops.

Immediate asks for our reply to Acme (EOD tomorrow):
- Ethan: stitch the 1-page risk checklist (Marissa), the BOM (Rishi) and a short decision table.
- Marissa: please produce the 1-page risk checklist by EOD tomorrow.
- Rishi: finalize the pilot BOM numbers and highlight the delta between VPC-only and air-gapped.
- Legal/Support note: We will include an SLA exception clause for pilot support; I will draft the language and route to legal — estimate 48 hours.

I'll schedule a 30-minute sync with Acme and invite CloudOps. Good work — keep the replies crisp.

—Laura
Laura Bennett
VP, Product & Compliance
Redwood Inference
